scope: Reusable explicit TCP resolver owner, lookup lifetime and replacement.

lookup.scope: Reusable TCP resolver configuration, per-call deadlines and owner replacement.

ownership.scope: Resolver replacement preserves a usable owner on seeding failure.

limitations: Configuration must already contain numeric endpoints and parsed search names; no OS settings loading or interface-name resolution.
Replacement and close require all borrowed operations to finish first.
No automatic reload, lease tracking, UDP, hosts-file policy or HTTP integration.
Native channel audit covers owner replacement; network tests verify exchange closure separately.
Existing isolated entropy/socket/timer candidate required; no compiler or installation changes.
